label: Philadelphia
note: The brand that gave the product its generic name: queso filadelfia in Spain and Mexico

about.text: An American cream cheese brand, first made in 1872 by William Lawrence of Chester, New York, who tried to make Neufchâtel and added too much cream. It took the Philadelphia name in 1880 with the distributor A. L. Reynolds, and is now owned by Kraft Heinz and Mondelez International.

facts.v: 1872, Chester, New York: William Lawrence, trying to make Neufchâtel, added too much cream and got a richer, spreadable cheese
Sold as Philadelphia from 1880 with the distributor A. L. Reynolds; the name is not where it was made
Phenix Cheese Company, merged with Kraft in 1928 as Kraft-Phenix; today Kraft Heinz and Mondelez International
